title: 把一天安排得有张有弛：口头说清
goal: 围绕把一天安排得有张有弛，用清楚、具体且尊重对方的英语完成沟通。
pitfall: 信息要符合给定情境；参考表达是一种可行写法，不是必须照抄的唯一答案。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。你周三放学后有篮球训练，想把当天的阅读改到回家路上。说明变化和原因。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I have basketball practice after school on Wednesday. I will read on the bus home instead, so I can still make time for a story.
cases.points: 周三训练、阅读改在回家途中、调整原因
cases.strategy: 先说明要沟通的事情，再补上对方行动所需的具体信息。
cases.evidence: I have basketball practice after school on Wednesday.
cases.pitfall: 不要把周三的安排说成每天都一样。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。你想和同学一起复习，但不知道对方哪天有空。礼貌询问一天和一个合适的时段。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Would you like to review our notes together? Which day are you free, and would a short meeting after school work for you?
cases.points: 邀请、询问可用日期和时段
cases.strategy: 先说清自己需要什么，再用礼貌问句给对方一个可以回应的请求。
cases.evidence: Would you like to review our notes together?
cases.pitfall: 先询问，不能替同学决定所有时间。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。今晚只有二十分钟空闲。比较整理全部照片和准备明天的材料，选择先做哪件并给理由。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Sorting all my photos can wait. I will prepare tomorrow's materials first because I need them for school, and twenty minutes is not enough for both jobs.
cases.points: 两个任务、先后选择、与时间和需要相关的理由
cases.strategy: 两个选择都要提到，再用当前条件解释自己的取舍。
cases.evidence: Sorting all my photos can wait.
cases.pitfall: 不要声称两个任务都已完成。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。朋友说“做计划就不能休息”。解释你不同意，并给一条能兼顾任务和休息的办法。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: A plan can include rest as well as work. I could do one short task, take a break and then check what still needs doing.
cases.points: 澄清误解、给一个可执行办法
cases.strategy: 先说清需要澄清的误解，再给事实或提出可行的替代办法。
cases.evidence: A plan can include rest as well as work.
cases.pitfall: 不要把休息说成不努力。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。新情境：周六你原计划画画，但图书馆的书当天到期。向家人说明怎样调整，仍给画画留时间。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I need to return my library book on Saturday because it is due that day. I will do that first and draw after lunch. I do not have to cancel drawing completely.
cases.points: 新到期任务优先、保留兴趣活动、清楚顺序
cases.strategy: 先核对新情境的条件，再把学过的表达办法用在这件事上。
cases.evidence: I need to return my library book on Saturday because it is due that day.
cases.pitfall: 到期是周六，不要改成周日。

cases.stem: 用一段连贯的英文完成任务，不必逐字背诵参考表达。为新学期设计一个可调整的放学后计划。包含一项必做任务、一项喜欢的活动、休息，以及遇到任务变难时怎么改。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: My after-school plan has room to change. I will first prepare the things I need for the next day. Then I can spend some time drawing, which helps me relax. I will leave a short break between tasks. If homework takes longer than expected, I can move part of the drawing time to another day. I will review the plan after a week instead of deciding that one difficult evening means I have failed.
cases.points: 必做任务、兴趣、休息、调整办法和回顾
cases.strategy: 先列要点，按事情或论证的顺序串联，最后检查是否完成沟通目的。
cases.evidence: My after-school plan has room to change.
cases.pitfall: 不要安排到每分钟都满，也不要承诺每天绝对相同。

title: 校园活动与安全：口头说清
goal: 围绕校园活动与安全，用清楚、具体且尊重对方的英语完成沟通。
pitfall: 信息要符合给定情境；参考表达是一种可行写法，不是必须照抄的唯一答案。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。园艺社团周二四点在绿门集合。告诉新同学集合信息，并提醒先听老师讲工具用法。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Our garden club meets by the green gate at four on Tuesday. Please listen to the teacher's instructions before using any tools.
cases.points: 日期钟点、绿门、工具前先听说明
cases.strategy: 先说明要沟通的事情，再补上对方行动所需的具体信息。
cases.evidence: Our garden club meets by the green gate at four on Tuesday.
cases.pitfall: 绿门不是学校正门，不能混淆集合点。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。你看不懂参观活动的集合点说明。向老师礼貌询问集合地点，以及走散后应找谁。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Could you show me our meeting point for the visit? If I cannot find my group, which member of staff should I ask for help?
cases.points: 提出不明白之处、地点和求助对象两个问题
cases.strategy: 先说清自己需要什么，再用礼貌问句给对方一个可以回应的请求。
cases.evidence: Could you show me our meeting point for the visit?
cases.pitfall: 不要用猜测替代已确认的安排。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。园艺活动遇到路滑。比较在室外跑去种植区与到教室制作植物标签，选择合适的安排并说明原因。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: The path is slippery, so running to the planting area is not a good choice. We can make plant labels in the classroom and wait for the teacher's next instructions.
cases.points: 比较两种行动、选择室内、说明路滑原因
cases.strategy: 两个选择都要提到，再用当前条件解释自己的取舍。
cases.evidence: The path is slippery, so running to the planting area is not a good choice.
cases.pitfall: 不要为了完成任务擅自走危险路线。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。同学想在参观时独自离开队伍找近路。礼貌提醒原安排，并提出找工作人员询问。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: We agreed to stay with our group during the visit. Please do not leave alone to find a shortcut. We can ask a museum worker or our teacher for directions.
cases.points: 明确约定、提醒不独行、给替代行动
cases.strategy: 先说清需要澄清的误解，再给事实或提出可行的替代办法。
cases.evidence: We agreed to stay with our group during the visit.
cases.pitfall: 不要只指责同学而不给解决办法。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。新情境：体育活动前你发现地上有水。向老师说明位置、可能的问题，并询问是否先暂停这一区域的活动。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: There is water on the floor near the equipment cupboard. Someone might slip there. Could we stop using that area while you decide how to deal with it?
cases.points: 具体位置、可能滑倒、请老师决定
cases.strategy: 先核对新情境的条件，再把学过的表达办法用在这件事上。
cases.evidence: There is water on the floor near the equipment cupboard.
cases.pitfall: 学生报告问题，不要自行宣布场地已安全。

cases.stem: 用一段连贯的英文完成任务，不必逐字背诵参考表达。为一次班级参观完成一段准备说明。包含集合、跟组、走散求助和拍照规则；无法确认的细节要询问老师。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Before our class visit, we should check the meeting point and keep our group information with us. During the visit, we need to stay with our group. If we become separated, we should ask a staff member for help rather than leave the building alone. We should also read the signs before taking photographs. I will ask the teacher about any part of the plan that is still unclear, instead of guessing the arrangements.
cases.points: 集合信息、跟组、走散求助、拍照和确认未知
cases.strategy: 先列要点，按事情或论证的顺序串联，最后检查是否完成沟通目的。
cases.evidence: Before our class visit, we should check the meeting point and keep our group information with us.
cases.pitfall: 不要编造已经得到老师确认的路线或时间。

pitfall: 信息要符合给定情境；参考表达是一种可行写法，不是必须照抄的唯一答案。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。你最近因为班级发言而担心，想向老师求助。说明具体困扰，并请求课后私下谈一谈。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I am worried about our class talk. Could I speak to you privately after the lesson? I would like some help planning the first few steps.
cases.points: 具体困扰、私下交流请求、希望得到的帮助
cases.strategy: 先说明要沟通的事情，再补上对方行动所需的具体信息。
cases.evidence: I am worried about our class talk.
cases.pitfall: 不要只写“我不好”而让对方猜发生什么。

cases.model: You seem tired today, and I am here to listen. Would you like to talk for a while, or would you prefer me to go with you to a trusted adult?
cases.points: 关心、给对方选择、成人支持
cases.strategy: 先说清自己需要什么，再用礼貌问句给对方一个可以回应的请求。

cases.pitfall: 不要替朋友诊断，也不要许诺自己能解决一切。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。比较硬撑着独自做完所有任务和向成人说明困难后调整计划。选一种更适合当前疲惫状态的办法。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Trying to finish everything alone may make this evening harder. I would rather explain the difficulty to an adult and make a more manageable plan with their help.
cases.points: 两个选择、当前疲惫、求助和调整

cases.evidence: Trying to finish everything alone may make this evening harder.
cases.pitfall: 不要保证调整后所有不适立即消失。

pitfall: 信息要符合给定情境；参考表达是一种可行写法，不是必须照抄的唯一答案。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。邀请来宾分享一道家常菜的故事。说明不需要带食物，也不要求代表整个国家。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Would you like to share a story about a dish your family enjoys? You do not need to bring food or speak for a whole country. Your own experience is enough.
cases.points: 邀请、个人范围、无需带食物
cases.strategy: 先说明要沟通的事情，再补上对方行动所需的具体信息。
cases.evidence: Would you like to share a story about a dish your family enjoys?
cases.pitfall: 不要让个人承担代表所有人的任务。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。去朋友家前，你想知道晚饭时间。礼貌询问，并说明好安排自己的时间。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Could you tell me what time your family plans to have dinner when I visit? I would like to arrange my afternoon and know what to expect.
cases.points: 具体时间问题、礼貌理由
cases.strategy: 先说清自己需要什么，再用礼貌问句给对方一个可以回应的请求。
cases.evidence: Could you tell me what time your family plans to have dinner when I visit?
cases.pitfall: 不要把一次安排问成“你们国家是不是永远都这样”。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。比较问“所有人都吃这个吗”与问“你家什么时候做这道菜”。选更适合了解个人经历的问题。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I would ask when the person's family makes the dish. That question leaves room for a particular experience instead of assuming that everyone in a country follows the same custom.
cases.points: 两种问法、个人范围、理由
cases.strategy: 两个选择都要提到，再用当前条件解释自己的取舍。
cases.evidence: I would ask when the person's family makes the dish.
cases.pitfall: 开放提问也要尊重对方不愿回答的内容。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。你差点把一次较晚的晚饭写成全地区的习惯。改写成只描述自己那次经历，并承认不能推广。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Dinner was later than I expected on that visit. My friend explained that the time can change. I can describe what happened to me, but I should not say that everyone there always eats late.
cases.points: 具体经历、补充说明、避免全称
cases.strategy: 先说清需要澄清的误解，再给事实或提出可行的替代办法。
cases.evidence: Dinner was later than I expected on that visit.
cases.pitfall: 不要用 always 和 everyone 夸大一次观察。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。新情境：你想展示一张聚会照片，里面有别人。先征求这次展示的许可，并提出不展示人物的替代。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: May I show this photograph during our class discussion? If anyone in it would rather not appear, I can use a picture of the food or make a drawing instead.
cases.points: 特定用途许可、尊重选择、替代办法
cases.strategy: 先核对新情境的条件，再把学过的表达办法用在这件事上。
cases.evidence: May I show this photograph during our class discussion?
cases.pitfall: 以前同意拍照不自动等于同意本次公开展示。

cases.stem: 用一段连贯的英文完成任务，不必逐字背诵参考表达。总结一次跨文化或家庭习惯交流的合适做法。包括具体经验、礼貌提问、说明自己的需要和不做过度推断。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: A useful exchange begins with listening to one person's experience. I can ask when their family makes a dish or what an object means to them, without asking them to represent everyone. If I have a practical need, such as knowing a meal time, I should explain it politely. I should also accept that some questions are personal. Afterwards, I can describe the visit accurately and keep its limits clear. Differences can lead to good questions without becoming rules about a whole country.
cases.points: 倾听、个人经验、礼貌提问、需求和范围
cases.strategy: 先列要点，按事情或论证的顺序串联，最后检查是否完成沟通目的。
cases.evidence: A useful exchange begins with listening to one person's experience.
cases.pitfall: 尊重差异不等于假装没有差异，也不等于把它夸大。

title: 理解艺术与表达感受：口头说清
goal: 围绕理解艺术与表达感受，用清楚、具体且尊重对方的英语完成沟通。
pitfall: 信息要符合给定情境；参考表达是一种可行写法，不是必须照抄的唯一答案。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。描述一幅画中你能直接看到的两个细节，再用一句话说个人感受，区分观察与解释。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I can see an empty chair beside a bright window. There is open space near the door. To me, the scene feels quiet, but that is my interpretation rather than a fact about the artist.
cases.points: 两个可见细节、个人感受、区分事实
cases.strategy: 先说明要沟通的事情，再补上对方行动所需的具体信息。
cases.evidence: I can see an empty chair beside a bright window.
cases.pitfall: 感受不能直接变成对艺术家人生的事实判断。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。同学对同一幅画有不同感受。请他指出支持其想法的一个画面细节。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: You said the picture feels hopeful to you. Which detail gave you that feeling? I would like to understand your reading rather than decide that only one response is allowed.
cases.points: 尊重不同感受、要求具体依据
cases.strategy: 先说清自己需要什么，再用礼貌问句给对方一个可以回应的请求。
cases.evidence: You said the picture feels hopeful to you.
cases.pitfall: 不能只说“我感觉如此”就拒绝讨论文本或画面。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。比较只说“这首诗很好”和联系某个词说明喜欢的原因。说明你想采用的表达方式。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Instead of saying only that I like the poem, I would mention the phrase about quiet water. It helps me imagine the reflection returning after the wheel has passed.
cases.points: 笼统与具体的比较、诗句联系
cases.strategy: 两个选择都要提到，再用当前条件解释自己的取舍。
cases.evidence: Instead of saying only that I like the poem, I would mention the phrase about quiet water.
cases.pitfall: 诗中比喻不是实际气象观测结论。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。有人把诗中的“小云”当成科学云类。解释这是水中景象的文学表达，不是天气分类。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: The little cloud is an image in this poem, not a scientific name for a kind of cloud. The programme note connects it with water near the bench and a reflected tree.
cases.points: 文学形象、说明文字、非科学分类
cases.strategy: 先说清需要澄清的误解，再给事实或提出可行的替代办法。
cases.evidence: The little cloud is an image in this poem, not a scientific name for a kind of cloud.
cases.pitfall: 不要因为是比喻就说诗里完全没有可理解的对象。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。新情境：同学创作了一张留白很多的海报。先描述你注意的地方，再提出开放问题，不替作者断言动机。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I noticed a large empty space beside the main picture. What did you want viewers to consider there? I have an idea, but I would like to hear your explanation first.
cases.points: 具体观察、开放问题、保留个人解释
cases.strategy: 先核对新情境的条件，再把学过的表达办法用在这件事上。
cases.evidence: I noticed a large empty space beside the main picture.
cases.pitfall: 留白不自动等于作者忘记画完。

cases.stem: 用一段连贯的英文完成任务，不必逐字背诵参考表达。推荐一件虚构艺术作品。包含两个细节、自己的感受、支持依据，并承认别人可能有不同理解。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I would recommend a classroom poster called Waiting for a Friend. It shows an empty chair beside a window and leaves open space near the door. Those details make me imagine someone arriving, so I find the scene hopeful. Another viewer might feel lonely instead. We could compare which part of the picture supports each response. I would not use my feeling to claim a fact about the artist's private life. Describing carefully gives a personal interpretation something clear to rest on.
cases.points: 作品信息、细节、感受与依据、允许不同理解
cases.strategy: 先列要点，按事情或论证的顺序串联，最后检查是否完成沟通目的。
cases.evidence: I would recommend a classroom poster called Waiting for a Friend.
cases.pitfall: 推荐是个人判断，不是官方唯一正确解读。

cases.model: Each team has four players, and everyone must touch the ball before the team scores. The rule encourages passing and participation instead of leaving every action to the strongest player.

cases.evidence: Each team has four players, and everyone must touch the ball before the team scores.

goal: 围绕公共规则与个人信息保护，用清楚、具体且尊重对方的英语完成沟通。
pitfall: 信息要符合给定情境；参考表达是一种可行写法，不是必须照抄的唯一答案。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。想把班级照片用于公开页面。说明分享前必须确认具体用途和照片中人的同意。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Before posting the class photograph, we need to explain where it will appear and ask the people shown. Permission for a private class chat does not automatically cover a public page.
cases.points: 具体用途、他人同意、私人与公开区别
cases.strategy: 先说明要沟通的事情，再补上对方行动所需的具体信息。
cases.evidence: Before posting the class photograph, we need to explain where it will appear and ask the people shown.
cases.pitfall: 以前拍过照片不代表现在可任意公开。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。你想拍自习室做项目，但不想拍到访客。向工作人员询问有没有空桌的合适时段。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I would like a picture of the study room for a school project without showing visitors. Is there a time when the tables are empty, or another way you would recommend?
cases.points: 目的、避免人物、请求合适方案
cases.strategy: 先说清自己需要什么，再用礼貌问句给对方一个可以回应的请求。
cases.evidence: I would like a picture of the study room for a school project without showing visitors.
cases.pitfall: 不能要求所有访客为个人拍照而离开。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。比较直接移动空座位上的包和先问工作人员。说明你会怎样做，为什么不能仅凭几分钟无人就认定弃用。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I would ask the room worker before moving the bag. A person may have left for only a few minutes, so an empty seat does not prove their belongings have been abandoned.
cases.points: 两种行动、证据限度、尊重物品
cases.strategy: 两个选择都要提到，再用当前条件解释自己的取舍。
cases.evidence: I would ask the room worker before moving the bag.
cases.pitfall: 不要擅自翻包寻找身份资料。

cases.strategy: 先说清需要澄清的误解，再给事实或提出可行的替代办法。
cases.evidence: Deleting my copy cannot guarantee that every forwarded copy has gone.
cases.pitfall: 不能保证已经掌控所有转发副本。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。新情境：活动照片背景里有姓名和电话。向小组指出问题，并建议换项目特写或图画。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

cases.strategy: 先核对新情境的条件，再把学过的表达办法用在这件事上。
cases.evidence: The background noticeboard shows names and phone numbers.
cases.pitfall: 不要在提醒时再次公开复述电话号码。

cases.stem: 用一段连贯的英文完成任务，不必逐字背诵参考表达。为班级完成一份分享照片前的检查说明。包含用途、同意、背景、不同意者的选择和出错后的求助。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Before sharing a photograph, check its purpose and who will see it. Ask the people shown whether they agree to that use, and inspect the background for private details. If someone does not want to appear, choose another picture or an original drawing instead of pressuring them. If an unsuitable image has already been shared, tell a trusted adult and ask how to limit further sharing. Deleting one copy is a useful step, but it cannot guarantee that every copy has disappeared.
cases.points: 用途、同意、背景、尊重选择、求助与局限
cases.strategy: 先列要点，按事情或论证的顺序串联，最后检查是否完成沟通目的。
cases.evidence: Before sharing a photograph, check its purpose and who will see it.
cases.pitfall: 检查说明不是保证数据绝对安全的承诺。

title: 地球、太空与探索：口头说清

pitfall: 信息要符合给定情境；参考表达是一种可行写法，不是必须照抄的唯一答案。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。介绍月球观测记录：记时间、外形和云遮挡。说明看不见不等于月球消失。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: We record the time, the Moon's visible shape and any clouds blocking our view. A cloudy evening means we could not see clearly; it does not prove that the Moon disappeared.
cases.points: 记录条件、外观、观察与结论区别
cases.strategy: 先说明要沟通的事情，再补上对方行动所需的具体信息。
cases.evidence: We record the time, the Moon's visible shape and any clouds blocking our view.
cases.pitfall: 不要把观察不到与对象不存在混为一谈。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。你不理解课堂球灯模型的比例。向老师问哪些大小和距离不是按比例表示。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Which sizes and distances in this model are not to scale? Could you explain what the ball and lamp help us understand, and what details the model leaves out?
cases.points: 比例问题、模型用途和局限
cases.strategy: 先说清自己需要什么，再用礼貌问句给对方一个可以回应的请求。
cases.evidence: Which sizes and distances in this model are not to scale?
cases.pitfall: 不能把台灯和小球当作完整真实系统。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。比较先定一个调查问题再选工具与只选最酷的设备。说明为什么相机是否合适取决于问题。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: I would choose the question first. If we want to compare surface pictures, a camera fits that aim better than a tool chosen only because it looks exciting. Different questions may need different evidence.
cases.points: 先问题后工具、具体任务匹配
cases.strategy: 两个选择都要提到，再用当前条件解释自己的取舍。
cases.evidence: I would choose the question first.
cases.pitfall: 不能说某一种工具能够回答所有太空问题。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。同学看到一张有趣形状的图片就宣布发现生命。温和纠正，并说明还需进一步证据。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: An interesting shape is worth investigating, but it does not by itself prove that life has been found. We should describe what the image shows and ask what further evidence would test that idea.
cases.points: 观察与生命结论区别、进一步检验
cases.strategy: 先说清需要澄清的误解，再给事实或提出可行的替代办法。
cases.evidence: An interesting shape is worth investigating, but it does not by itself prove that life has been found.
cases.pitfall: 不要把愿望或想象写成已经确认的发现。

cases.stem: 说2—4句英文。新情境：你们为纸上探测任务画了虚构地图。给展示者一个提醒：标明地名虚构、地图范围和未知。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Our place names and map are invented for the project, so the display should say that clearly. We should also mark what our design does not test rather than present the map as a real mission result.
cases.points: 虚构标记、设计范围、非真实任务成果
cases.strategy: 先核对新情境的条件，再把学过的表达办法用在这件事上。
cases.evidence: Our place names and map are invented for the project, so the display should say that clearly.
cases.pitfall: 不能虚构真实发射日期、发现或机构背书。

cases.stem: 用一段连贯的英文完成任务，不必逐字背诵参考表达。为虚构太空探究项目完成总结。包含具体问题、相应工具、观测记录、模型局限和结论所需证据。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。
cases.model: Our fictional mission asks how two surface areas compare in pictures. A camera suits that question, but a clear image would not explain everything beneath the surface. We would record the conditions and separate what we observe from what we infer. Any classroom model needs labels explaining where its sizes or distances are not to scale. An unusual shape could lead to a new question, not an immediate announcement of life. Useful exploration combines curiosity with careful aims, evidence and honest limits.
cases.points: 具体问题、工具匹配、记录与推断、比例限制、结论证据
cases.strategy: 先列要点，按事情或论证的顺序串联，最后检查是否完成沟通目的。
cases.evidence: Our fictional mission asks how two surface areas compare in pictures.
cases.pitfall: 科学兴趣不是编造发现的理由。
